approval_evidence.quote: This new drug application provides for the use of PREZISTATM (darunavir) tablets, co-administered with 100 mg of ritonavir, for the treatment of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection in antiretroviral treatment-experienced adult patients

series_start_reason: J&J first prints a PREZISTA line (US, Intl, WW rows) in the 2009Q1 earnings exhibit 99.2 (Form 8-K, 2009-04-14), which also prints 2008Q1; the 2009Q2, Q3 and Q4 exhibits print 2008Q2-Q4 as prior-year columns (88, 79, 93), so the series starts at 2008Q1. J&J's 2008 earnings exhibits (8-K, 2008-01 to 2009-01) and its 2006-2008 Forms 10-Q and 10-K mention PREZISTA only in prose with no figure (measured, see search_log). FDA approval was 2006 and a European launch is dated 2007 in J&J's FY2007 annual report, so launch_quarter is null: no document located dates the first sale to a quarter, and the series starts later than launch.
series_end_reason: From the 2015Q1 schedule J&J prints the line as 'PREZISTA / PREZCOBIX' (2015Q1, Q2), then 'PREZISTA / PREZCOBIX / REZOLSTA' and later 'PREZISTA / PREZCOBIX / REZOLSTA / SYMTUZA' (the 2026Q2 schedule). No PREZISTA-only row is printed from 2015Q1 on, and the combined line adds new products, so it is a different scope and is not spliced. The last PREZISTA-only quarter is 2014Q4 (the 4Q2014 schedule prints PREZISTA WW 448 vs 461).
notes: Scope is the worldwide (US + Intl) PREZISTA line; the US and Intl rows are printed in every document. Annual cross-check against the stated full years: 2008 74+88+79+93=334 (FY2009 exhibit prior-year column 334), 2009 122+140+151+179=592, 2010 187+204+230+236=857, 2011 266+313+316+316=1,211, 2012 324+373+364+353=1,414, 2013 367+435+410+461=1,673, 2014 445+492+446+448=1,831 (FY2014 schedule WW twelve months 1,831); each stated full year in the Q4 exhibit equals the sum. The 2015Q1-2026Q2 combined lines (PREZISTA / PREZCOBIX / REZOLSTA / SYMTUZA) are a different scope and are not included. PREZISTA was developed by Tibotec (a Janssen company, J&J).
search_log: Listed J&J (CIK 200406) Form 8-K Item 2.02 filings 2006-01 to 2014-12 via data.sec.gov submissions (form filter: any form beginning 8-K with item 2.02, which includes the 8-K/A of 2008-08-04) and downloaded every exhibit; searched case-insensitively for PREZISTA. Figures appear in the exhibit 99.2 segment-sales schedules of the 2009-04-14 release through the 2014-10-14 release; the 2006-2008 releases (2006-01-24 to 2009-01-20) carry PREZISTA only in prose (approval and regulatory sentences) with no figure.

Downloaded the J&J Form 10-Q and 10-K (exhibit 13) documents 2006Q1-2014Q2 used by the sibling J&J Remicade manifest (38 documents) and searched them for PREZISTA: figures appear only from the 2012Q1 10-Q on (Infectious Diseases table); 2006-2011 documents mention PREZISTA only in prose and patent-litigation text. The 8-K schedules were cited instead because they begin earlier and print the quarter as current.
4Q2014 figures (448 and prior-year 461) are read from J&J's investor-site schedule PDF (pdfplumber text); the 2015-01 earnings 8-K was not used.

2008Q1-2008Q4 are direct_prior_year_column rows from the 2009Q1-2009Q4 exhibits: no J&J document prints a 2008 quarter as current. Nine months 2008 is not separately printed; the 2009Q3 exhibit's prior-year nine-month column is 241 = 74+88+79, and its prior-year twelve-month column 334 = 241+93.

From 2015Q1: downloaded J&J schedule PDFs 2014Q3-2026Q2 (via the sibling staging cache) and grepped PREZISTA: the line is combined with PREZCOBIX (2015Q1) and later REZOLSTA and SYMTUZA; a sibling exclusion records that PREZCOBIX is not printed alone either.

Partner/royalty rung: Gilead's Symtuza revenue share is a different measure; no other issuer prints PREZISTA net sales. Bigdata.com search was not informative for this line; the original SEC exhibits were located by EDGAR submissions.
